title: LeagueBridge production native observation v1 signature envelope
description: Score-free signed Ed25519 envelope with an embedded base64url payload. The two signatures are ordered lab observer then independent reviewer under a separate application-owned trust policy. The Go verifier enforces distinct principals and organizations, key scope, validity, revocation, signatures, canonical bytes, and the 131072-byte envelope bound.

payload.description: Unpadded base64url of at most 32768 decoded canonical JSON bytes. The Go verifier decodes and re-encodes identically.

$comment: JSON Schema cannot establish that the signatures are over the exact decoded payload bytes, that key IDs differ, or that the second signature follows the first in time; the Go verifier enforces these requirements.
